claim: A change moving a folder respells every path it finds in a body, and a finding's `claim` and `evidence` are bodies like any other. Where a finding says what a path was at a past commit, that sentence is respelled to the path of today, and the finding then says the past commit did something it did not do. Nothing refuses it and nothing marks it: the change reports the finding among the files it repointed, which reads exactly like the mend that keeps a finding true. A finding holds the evidence a decision rests on, so it is the one body in the repository whose past tense must not follow a move.

evidence:
Moving `temper/lorebook` to `temper/catalog/world/lorebook` repointed `domain/finding/pages/a-rename-voids-the-lint-exemption-keyed-to-the-folder-it-moves.finding.ts`, whose evidence reads `and the rename had carried those modules to ``temper/lorebook/modules/```. The move would have left that reading `temper/catalog/world/lorebook/modules/`. The sentence is about commit `daf387e7adb956e9755a82d5778419099a764b9b`, which carried those modules to `temper/lorebook/modules/` and nowhere else, so the respelled sentence is false of the commit it names. It was restored by a `change-file` in the same fold, and the move landed as `57ccad94054829bb5ad0ce03000873edf52e09b9`.

The same move respelled a path in `a-lost-draft-reads-as-a-smaller-draft-rather-than-a-lost-one`, and there it was right: that sentence is present tense and says where the thing is now. So the fault is not that a finding's prose is repointed. It is that a past-tense sentence and a present-tense one are repointed alike, and only a reader can tell which is which.

What makes it likely to be missed: the restored line and the respelled line differ by one path inside a long quotation, in a file the agent did not set out to change. Eight folder moves under `temper/catalog` landed in the same run, and every one of them could reach any finding quoting a path.

The condition a mend would meet: a change moving a file either leaves a finding's `claim` and `evidence` alone, or names each finding it would repoint and holds that repointing back until an agent has read it.
